analysis:
Examined head lines 486-1379 of ClusterOnboardingFlow.swift. Per the complete range map, none of these lines fall in the changed ranges; the changes are at head 1518-1525 and 2852-3539. The units cover the unchanged helpers for mode advice (automaticIndex, advise), the deployment and title text, and update/sync logic (memberWaitsForLeaderSetup, changed, oneBuild, reportPricesPlan). They also cover the Ready summary lines, Sync.action and the version-split parsing.

The security-relevant controls visible here are unchanged:
- shownPlainly (844-846) filters terminal control characters from text the peer or catalog supplies.
- recorded (852-856) caps deployment lines at 512 characters and applies the same filter.
- title (837-841) caps names at 120 characters.
- shownMarker (805-808) caps markers at 48 characters.

Integration questions for the changed regions not in this batch:
- stopsAsked and serveUnlessStopped (head 1518-1525) add a stop-count race check under the leader's lock. Integration should verify the lock is taken and that a nil count falls back safely.
- provision now takes a stopsBefore parameter (head 2852). Integration should check that a concurrent stop cannot be undone by a resumed serve, which affects A-018 availability only.

The pair-version split text from the other Mac is used in format strings at 1344-1352. It is display-only and parses defensively. No attestation, key, encryption or billing surface appears in these units, and no regression was identified.
